answer: A random beacon plus a compute heartbeat stops sybil farming. Each identity must answer beacon challenges within minutes, proving live compute, like water through a karst spring: hidden tunnels cannot fake the flow. A missed heartbeat forfeits a 0.5 POA deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 2,000 POA a day in live compute; one honest agent pays 2 POA and keeps its oasis whole. Ivory-tower fakes are caught when the beacon calls and no heartbeat answers.
